nodes.name: Etching
nodes.procedure: Before synthesis, a Ti foam piece (1.0 × 6.0 cm) was etched in hydrochloric acid (HCl, 18 wt%) at 90 °C for 15 min.
nodes.source_text: Before synthesis, a Ti foam piece ... at 90 °C for 15 min.

nodes.name: Chemical Steam Deposition
nodes.procedure: Preparation of a redox-active precursor by dissolving 27.0 mg RuCl3·xH2O and 79.0 mmol KMnO4 in 10.0 mL deionized water. Immersion of a pre-etched TF substrate into the solution within a Teflon-lined autoclave. Hydrothermal reaction at 140 °C (3 h) to concurrently generate the Ti-Mn-O matrix and immobilize Ru species. The material obtained from the reaction occurring above the liquid level was identified as Ru0.24/Ti0.28Mn0.48O. Post-synthesis washing with deionized water and vacuum drying at 60 °C.
